audit.why: Early Sylas-favored (Irelia weak pre-resets), flips at 6/first item, Sylas re-takes at two items. Prose matches packet chart; only the full-layer sides disagreed.
Spikes: Sylas 3 (full chains), 6 (steal), 2 items; Irelia 6 (R 125s) + first item / stacked Ionian Fervor. Content spikes[] covers all four.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; whys[4] called Irelia's all-in 'point-and-click' (both R and E are dodgeable); several fields misgendered Irelia.
audit.why: Irelia E Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, R Vanguard's Edge 125/105/85s — both skillshots. Sylas W heal is his trade refund (12s rank 1).
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers added; 'point-and-click' removed; pronouns fixed.

notes: Full-layer chart said Irelia levels 1-5 while content win[] and the packet both said Sylas 1-4, Irelia 6/first-item, Sylas 2+ items — moved full sides to agree (win[] already correct, so side-only per the chart rule; whys for phases 4-5 rewritten to match the Irelia verdict, phases 2/3/6 whys already described the new side). Kit flag check: Irelia E is flagged 'grounding' but Riot's text says stun+Mark only — trusted the description, wrote no grounding claim. Irelia R flag says 'terrain'; the text says the blade wall damages and slows, not true terrain — no terrain claim written. Missing-interaction (anti-heal vs Bladesurge sustain) already covered by report[8], pronoun fixed there. Cannot verify from kits whether Sylas E2 chain interrupts Irelia W charge — did not claim it; dosFull[1].d only says to chain her during the telegraph.
